items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex up 100 pts, Nifty above 23,050; auto, realty shares sign
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.07 per cent and 0.19 per cent, respectively

items.title: ESDS shares hit 5% lower circuit as Q1 PAT halves; up 310% from IPO price
items.description: Based on today's low and issue price of ₹429, ESDS IPO investors are currently enjoying a 310 per cent return in less than a month despite today's fall.

items.title: Analysts 'neutral' on German Green Steel IPO despite attractive valuations
items.description: German Green Steel IPO Review: Analysts suggested observing German Green Steel's performance for one to two quarters post listing as the company is exposed to a highly cyclical industry.

items.title: Whirlpool of India zooms 33% in 3 days; what's driving stock price?
items.description: The average trading volume on the Whirlpool of India counter jumped nearly three-fold with a combined 8 million shares changing hands on the NSE and BSE till 10:26 AM on Friday.

items.title: Meesho's valuation woes prompt Nomura to assign 'Reduce' tag; stock down 5%
items.description: At the current price, Nomura said that Meesho trades at a premium to Eternal and Swiggy, despite their higher NMV growth and cash-cow food delivery businesses.

items.title: NSE shares dip on day 2 of listing, brokerages back long-term growth story
items.description: Brokerage firm Emkay, among others, initiated coverage on NSE with a 'Buy' rating and an estimated target price of ₹2,050.

items.title: Welspun Corp jump 5% as US arm wins ₹4,000 cr order; up 4-fold from Feb low
items.description: In the past two months, Welspun Corp's share price appreciated by 78%, and zoomed 300% from its 52-week low price of ₹709.95 touched on February 2, 2026.

items.title: PB Fintech faces up to 46% earnings risk from Irdai's draft rules: Analysts
items.description: Jefferies noted that Irdai's proposed changes could have a "material adverse impact on PB Fintech's near-term earnings".

items.title: Ola shares snap 4-day rally, crash 9% ahead of board meet to raise funds
items.description: Ola shares remain 4 per cent higher in 2026 so far, but have lost 30 per cent in a year.

items.title: Asian shares steady as bond selloff lifts US yields to two-decade highs
items.description: Asian shares held steady as a global bond selloff pushed long-term US yields to multi-year highs

items.title: Stocks to watch: PB Fintech, MCX, NSE, Inox Green, Waaree Energies, Dr Lal
items.description: PB Fintech flagged potential pressure on general insurance revenue and agent commissions, while saying its life insurance business would see limited impact.

items.title: F&O: Analyst suggests bear, bull spreads on Bank Nifty, Canara Bank
items.description: Nandish Shah of HDFC Securities has recommended a Bear spread on Bank Nifty and a Bull spread on Canara Bank.
